item.title: What is the difference between phone call blocking and screening?
item.description: Phone call blocking and call screening are two different ways to handle unwanted calls. Call blocking stops specific numbers from reaching you entirely, sending them straight to a silent rejection without your phone ringing. Call screening lets unknown calls come through but shows you information about the caller before you decide whether to answer.
